paper_title: Searching for Time-Dependent Axion Dark Matter Signals in Pulsars
notes: First time-domain search for axion dark matter radio signals from pulsar PSR J2144-3933 using MeerKAT (MeerTIME). Observed 2-sigma (~95% CL) upper limit g_agamma < 5.5e-11 GeV^-1 over m_a = 3.9-4.7 ueV, assuming pulsar distance D = 0.165 kpc (parallax) and local DM density 0.45 GeV/cm^3 extrapolated via NFW profile. Limit scales linearly with D; a weaker limit of 9.6e-11 GeV^-1 applies if D = 0.29 kpc (electron-density model). Limit relies on excluding aligned-rotator geometries (alpha > 20 deg, |beta| < 4 deg). The v1 abstract quotes 4e-11 but the updated (v2) text quotes 5.5e-11, which is used here. Encoded as a flat bound over the stated validity mass range. Projections for SKA1-mid (~1.6e-11) and Galactic Centre Magnetar (~4e-12) are discussed but not included as data. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.8, 2))
